senses.def: not nice to look at
senses.ex: I think that building is really ugly.
senses.exPt: Acho aquele prédio muito feio.

senses.def: a thing you hold over your head to keep dry in the rain
senses.ex: Take an umbrella. It's going to rain.
senses.exPt: Leve um guarda-chuva. Vai chover.

senses.def: not able to do something
senses.ex: Many people were unable to get home because of the storm.
senses.exPt: Muita gente não conseguiu voltar para casa por causa da tempestade.

senses.def: not afraid or nervous
senses.ex: She walked into the dark room, completely unafraid.
senses.exPt: Ela entrou no quarto escuro, totalmente sem medo.

senses.def: very surprising, or difficult to believe
senses.ex: The view from the top of the mountain was unbelievable.
senses.exPt: A vista do alto da montanha era inacreditável.

senses.def: not known or not decided yet
senses.ex: The future of the company is uncertain.
senses.exPt: O futuro da empresa é incerto.

senses.def: not sure about something
senses.ex: I'm uncertain about what to do next.
senses.exPt: Estou em dúvida sobre o que fazer agora.

senses.def: a situation in which something is not known or certain
senses.ex: There is a lot of uncertainty about the future of the company.
senses.exPt: Há muita incerteza sobre o futuro da empresa.

senses.def: the brother of your mother or father, or your aunt's husband
senses.ex: My uncle has a small restaurant in the city.
senses.exPt: Meu tio tem um pequeno restaurante na cidade.

senses.def: not known or not certain
senses.ex: It's still unclear what caused the fire.
senses.exPt: Ainda não está claro o que causou o incêndio.

senses.def: not easy to understand
senses.ex: The teacher's instructions were a bit unclear.
senses.exPt: As instruções do professor estavam um pouco confusas.

senses.def: not pleasant to wear, sit on, etc.
senses.ex: These shoes are really uncomfortable.
senses.exPt: Esses sapatos são muito desconfortáveis.

senses.def: feeling worried or embarrassed in a situation
senses.ex: I felt uncomfortable when they started arguing.
senses.exPt: Fiquei incomodado quando eles começaram a discutir.

senses.def: too strong or wild to be controlled
senses.ex: She had an uncontrollable urge to laugh during the meeting.
senses.exPt: Ela teve uma vontade incontrolável de rir durante a reunião.

senses.def: to find out something that was secret or hidden
senses.ex: The police uncovered a plan to rob the bank.
senses.exPt: A polícia descobriu um plano para roubar o banco.

senses.def: in a lower position than something
senses.ex: The cat is sleeping under the bed.
senses.exPt: O gato está dormindo embaixo da cama.

senses.def: less than a number or age
senses.ex: Children under five travel for free.
senses.exPt: Crianças menores de cinco anos viajam de graça.

senses.def: too young by law to do something, such as drink alcohol
senses.ex: Shops can't sell alcohol to underage customers.
senses.exPt: As lojas não podem vender bebida alcoólica para clientes menores de idade.

senses.def: to experience something, especially something unpleasant or necessary
senses.ex: My father had to undergo heart surgery last year.
senses.exPt: Meu pai teve que passar por uma cirurgia no coração no ano passado.

senses.def: to draw a line under a word or sentence
senses.ex: Read the text and underline the new words.
senses.exPt: Leia o texto e sublinhe as palavras novas.

senses.def: under or below something, often hidden by it
senses.ex: I found my keys underneath the sofa.
senses.exPt: Encontrei minhas chaves embaixo do sofá.

senses.def: a piece of underwear worn below the waist
senses.ex: He packed three pairs of underpants for the trip.
senses.exPt: Ele colocou três cuecas na mala para a viagem.

senses.def: to know what something means or why something happens
senses.ex: I don't understand this word.
senses.exPt: Não entendo esta palavra.

senses.def: below the surface of the water, or used there
senses.ex: I bought an underwater camera for my holiday.
senses.exPt: Comprei uma câmera subaquática para as férias.

senses.def: to remove the effect of something you have done
senses.ex: You can undo your last change by pressing this button.
senses.exPt: Você pode desfazer sua última alteração apertando este botão.

senses.def: to open something that is tied or fastened
senses.ex: She undid the buttons on her coat.
senses.exPt: Ela desabotoou o casaco.

senses.def: to take off your clothes
senses.ex: He undressed quickly and got into bed.
senses.exPt: Ele tirou a roupa rapidinho e foi para a cama.

senses.def: worried or nervous because you think something bad may happen
senses.ex: I felt uneasy about leaving her alone at home.
senses.exPt: Eu fiquei apreensivo em deixá-la sozinha em casa.

senses.def: without a job
senses.ex: My uncle has been unemployed for six months.
senses.exPt: Meu tio está desempregado há seis meses.

senses.def: the situation of not having a job, or the number of people without jobs
senses.ex: Unemployment is rising in the region.
senses.exPt: O desemprego está aumentando na região.

senses.def: surprising because you did not think it would happen
senses.ex: We had an unexpected visit from my uncle.
senses.exPt: Recebemos uma visita inesperada do meu tio.

senses.def: in a way that you did not expect
senses.ex: My uncle arrived unexpectedly on Sunday morning.
senses.exPt: Meu tio chegou sem avisar no domingo de manhã.

senses.def: not treating people in an equal or right way
senses.ex: It's unfair that I have to do all the work.
senses.exPt: É injusto eu ter que fazer todo o trabalho.

senses.def: in a way that is not right or fair
senses.ex: I think he was treated unfairly by his boss.
senses.exPt: Acho que ele foi tratado injustamente pelo chefe.

senses.def: not physically healthy or strong, because of not doing exercise
senses.ex: I'm so unfit that I can't even run for the bus.
senses.exPt: Estou tão fora de forma que nem consigo correr atrás do ônibus.

senses.def: not suitable or good enough for something
senses.ex: The water in this river is unfit to drink.
senses.exPt: A água deste rio é imprópria para beber.

senses.def: to open something that was folded
senses.ex: She unfolded the map on the table.
senses.exPt: Ela desdobrou o mapa na mesa.

senses.def: to develop or become clear as time passes
senses.ex: As the story unfolds, we learn more about the family.
senses.exPt: À medida que a história se desenrola, conhecemos melhor a família.

senses.def: so good or special that you will always remember it
senses.ex: Our trip to the mountains was unforgettable.
senses.exPt: Nossa viagem para as montanhas foi inesquecível.

senses.def: causing problems or regret; not suitable
senses.ex: It was an unfortunate mistake, but nobody was hurt.
senses.exPt: Foi um erro lamentável, mas ninguém se machucou.

senses.def: having bad luck
senses.ex: The unfortunate driver lost his car in the flood.
senses.exPt: O motorista azarado perdeu o carro na enchente.

senses.def: used to say that something is sad or disappointing
senses.ex: We wanted to go, but unfortunately it rained all day.
senses.exPt: Queríamos ir, mas infelizmente choveu o dia todo.

senses.def: not kind or pleasant to other people
senses.ex: The staff at the hotel were rude and unfriendly.
senses.exPt: Os funcionários do hotel eram grosseiros e antipáticos.

senses.def: not happy; sad
senses.ex: He was very unhappy at his old school.
senses.exPt: Ele era muito infeliz na escola antiga.

senses.def: not pleased with something
senses.ex: The customers were unhappy with the service.
senses.exPt: Os clientes ficaram insatisfeitos com o serviço.

senses.def: not good for your health, or not in good health
senses.ex: He has a very unhealthy lifestyle.
senses.exPt: Ele tem um estilo de vida pouco saudável.

senses.def: unheard of: never known or done before
senses.ex: Twenty years ago, working from home was almost unheard of.
senses.exPt: Vinte anos atrás, trabalhar de casa era algo quase inédito.

senses.def: not listened to or not given attention
senses.ex: Their complaints went unheard for years.
senses.exPt: As reclamações deles foram ignoradas durante anos.

senses.def: special clothes worn by everyone in a school, job or team
senses.ex: Do you have to wear a uniform at school?
senses.exPt: Você tem que usar uniforme na escola?

senses.def: to join people or parts together into one
senses.ex: The new leader wants to unify the country.
senses.exPt: O novo líder quer unificar o país.

senses.def: not important
senses.ex: Don't worry about it, it's an unimportant detail.
senses.exPt: Não se preocupe com isso, é um detalhe sem importância.

senses.def: not wanting to know about or take part in something
senses.ex: He seemed completely uninterested in the game.
senses.exPt: Ele parecia totalmente desinteressado no jogo.

senses.def: not interesting; boring
senses.ex: The film was long and uninteresting.
senses.exPt: O filme era longo e sem graça.

senses.def: an organization that protects workers' rights
senses.ex: He joined the union when he started work at the factory.
senses.exPt: Ele entrou no sindicato quando começou a trabalhar na fábrica.

senses.def: a group of countries or states joined together
senses.ex: Which countries are members of the European Union?
senses.exPt: Quais países são membros da União Europeia?

senses.def: being the only one of its kind
senses.ex: Every person's fingerprints are unique.
senses.exPt: As impressões digitais de cada pessoa são únicas.

senses.def: a single part of something bigger, or an amount used for measuring
senses.ex: Our English book has twelve units.
senses.exPt: Nosso livro de inglês tem doze unidades.

senses.def: to join together, or to make people join together
senses.ex: Music can unite people from different cultures.
senses.exPt: A música pode unir pessoas de culturas diferentes.

senses.def: everything that exists, including all the stars and planets
senses.ex: Do you think we are alone in the universe?
senses.exPt: Você acha que estamos sozinhos no universo?

senses.def: a place where people study for a degree after school
senses.ex: My sister studies medicine at university.
senses.exPt: Minha irmã estuda medicina na faculdade.

senses.def: not known or not famous
senses.ex: The cause of the fire is still unknown.
senses.exPt: A causa do incêndio ainda é desconhecida.

senses.def: except if
senses.ex: You can't go in unless you have a ticket.
senses.exPt: Você não pode entrar a menos que tenha ingresso.

senses.def: different from someone or something; in contrast to
senses.ex: Unlike my brother, I love sports.
senses.exPt: Ao contrário do meu irmão, eu adoro esportes.

senses.def: not likely to happen or be true
senses.ex: It's unlikely to rain this afternoon.
senses.exPt: É improvável que chova hoje à tarde.

senses.def: having bad luck
senses.ex: He has always been unlucky in love.
senses.exPt: Ele sempre foi azarado no amor.

senses.def: not needed
senses.ex: Try not to buy unnecessary things.
senses.exPt: Tente não comprar coisas desnecessárias.

senses.def: to take things out of a bag, suitcase or box
senses.ex: I arrived late and didn't unpack until the next day.
senses.exPt: Cheguei tarde e só fui desfazer a mala no dia seguinte.

senses.def: not nice or enjoyable
senses.ex: There was an unpleasant smell in the kitchen.
senses.exPt: Tinha um cheiro desagradável na cozinha.

senses.def: changing so often that you cannot know what will happen
senses.ex: The weather here is very unpredictable in spring.
senses.exPt: O tempo aqui é muito imprevisível na primavera.

senses.def: not connected to something else
senses.ex: He talked about something unrelated to the meeting.
senses.exPt: Ele falou de algo sem relação com a reunião.

senses.def: not neat or organized
senses.ex: His bedroom is always untidy and full of clothes.
senses.exPt: O quarto dele está sempre bagunçado e cheio de roupa.

senses.def: up to a particular time
senses.ex: The library is open until nine at night.
senses.exPt: A biblioteca fica aberta até as nove da noite.

senses.def: not usual; different from what normally happens
senses.ex: It's unusual to see snow here in April.
senses.exPt: É incomum ver neve aqui em abril.

senses.def: more than is normal or expected
senses.ex: It's unusually hot for October.
senses.exPt: Está fazendo um calor fora do comum para outubro.

senses.def: not wanted
senses.ex: How can I stop getting unwanted emails?
senses.exPt: Como posso parar de receber e-mails indesejados?

senses.def: ill, not feeling healthy
senses.ex: I left work early because I felt unwell.
senses.exPt: Saí do trabalho mais cedo porque estava me sentindo mal.

senses.def: towards a higher place on something
senses.ex: He ran up the stairs to his room.
senses.exPt: Ele subiu a escada correndo até o quarto.

senses.def: modern, or having the newest information
senses.ex: Make sure your phone's software is up-to-date.
senses.exPt: Verifique se o software do seu celular está atualizado.

senses.def: to make something more modern or add the newest information
senses.ex: I need to update the software on my laptop.
senses.exPt: Preciso atualizar o software do meu notebook.

senses.def: to give someone the latest news about something
senses.ex: Please keep me updated on the situation.
senses.exPt: Por favor, me mantenha informado sobre a situação.

senses.def: a newer version of something, or the latest news about it
senses.ex: There's a new update for this app.
senses.exPt: Tem uma atualização nova para esse aplicativo.

senses.def: feeling happier and more hopeful
senses.ex: I felt uplifted after talking to her.
senses.exPt: Eu me senti mais animado depois de conversar com ela.

senses.def: to move a file from your computer or phone to the internet
senses.ex: Can you upload the photos so everyone can see them?
senses.exPt: Você pode fazer upload das fotos para todo mundo ver?

senses.def: on; a more formal word for on
senses.ex: She placed the book upon the table.
senses.exPt: Ela colocou o livro sobre a mesa.

senses.def: higher than something else, or at the top
senses.ex: The bedrooms are on the upper floor.
senses.exPt: Os quartos ficam no andar de cima.

senses.def: unhappy or worried because something bad happened
senses.ex: She was upset because nobody remembered her birthday.
senses.exPt: Ela ficou chateada porque ninguém lembrou do aniversário dela.

senses.def: on or to a higher floor of a building
senses.ex: My bedroom is upstairs, next to the bathroom.
senses.exPt: Meu quarto fica lá em cima, ao lado do banheiro.

senses.def: towards a higher place
senses.ex: She looked upward at the stars in the sky.
senses.exPt: Ela olhou para cima, para as estrelas no céu.

senses.def: going towards a higher level or amount
senses.ex: House prices are showing an upward trend this year.
senses.exPt: Os preços dos imóveis estão numa tendência de alta este ano.

senses.def: a strong sudden wish to do something
senses.ex: I felt a sudden urge to laugh in the meeting.
senses.exPt: Senti uma vontade repentina de rir na reunião.

senses.def: to strongly advise or try to persuade someone to do something
senses.ex: Doctors urge people to eat more fruit and vegetables.
senses.exPt: Os médicos insistem para que as pessoas comam mais frutas e verduras.

senses.def: needing attention immediately
senses.ex: I need to talk to you. It's urgent.
senses.exPt: Preciso falar com você. É urgente.

senses.def: the speaker and other people, as the object of a verb or after a preposition
senses.ex: Can you help us with these bags?
senses.exPt: Você pode nos ajudar com essas sacolas?

senses.def: the amount of something used, or the way it is used
senses.ex: Our water usage goes up in the summer.
senses.exPt: Nosso consumo de água aumenta no verão.

senses.def: to do something with a thing for a purpose
senses.ex: Can I use your phone for a minute?
senses.exPt: Posso usar o seu celular um minutinho?

senses.def: used to: did something regularly in the past but not now
senses.ex: I used to play football every day when I was a child.
senses.exPt: Eu costumava jogar futebol todo dia quando era criança.

senses.def: be used to: familiar with something so it is not strange or difficult
senses.ex: I'm not used to getting up so early.
senses.exPt: Não estou acostumado a acordar tão cedo.

senses.def: already owned or used by someone else
senses.ex: We bought a used car because new ones are too expensive.
senses.exPt: Compramos um carro usado porque os novos são caros demais.

senses.def: did something regularly in the past but not now
senses.ex: I used to play football every weekend.
senses.exPt: Eu costumava jogar futebol todo fim de semana.

senses.def: be used to: familiar with something, so it is not strange
senses.ex: I'm used to getting up early for work.
senses.exPt: Estou acostumado a acordar cedo para trabalhar.

senses.def: helping you to do or get something
senses.ex: This app is very useful for learning English.
senses.exPt: Este aplicativo é muito útil para aprender inglês.

senses.def: not useful; not working or not helping
senses.ex: This old phone charger is useless now.
senses.exPt: Este carregador de celular velho agora é inútil.

senses.def: the same as what normally happens
senses.ex: Let's meet at the usual place after work.
senses.exPt: Vamos nos encontrar no lugar de sempre depois do trabalho.

senses.def: in the way that happens most often
senses.ex: I usually get up at seven o'clock.
senses.exPt: Eu geralmente acordo às sete horas.
